principles: Semantic understanding and authorization are separate decisions.
Recognizing an order reference, account target, product, operation, or requested value never grants permission.
Private order and payment facts are limited to the authenticated owner.
Public catalog, product, shipping-setting, store-contact, approved-knowledge, and safe social reads do not acquire private-data authority.
A denied or unauthenticated request retains its understood entities and receives the corresponding security terminal.

authorization_states.name: anonymous
authorization_states.business_meaning: No authenticated customer identity is established.
authorization_states.allowed_scope: Public reads and non-factual social interaction only; private order or payment reads require authentication.
authorization_states.provenance: Frozen sanitized schema contract and published business knowledge

authorization_states.name: anonymous_or_authenticated
authorization_states.business_meaning: The capability is public and does not depend on customer identity.
authorization_states.allowed_scope: Public structured facts, properly supported published knowledge, and safe social interaction.

authorization_states.name: authenticated_non_owner
authorization_states.business_meaning: A customer identity is established, but the targeted private resource does not belong to that customer.
authorization_states.allowed_scope: No access to the targeted private order or payment data.
authorization_states.provenance: Frozen sanitized schema contract and published order guidance

authorization_states.name: authenticated_owner
authorization_states.business_meaning: A customer identity is established and ownership of the targeted private resource is established.
authorization_states.allowed_scope: Read-only access to that customer's order and payment-status facts.
authorization_states.provenance: Frozen sanitized schema contract and published order guidance

authorization_states.name: authenticated_verified_customer
authorization_states.business_meaning: The customer is authenticated and email verification is complete.
authorization_states.allowed_scope: Public and owned reads plus eligible suggested cart actions; the suggestion still requires explicit confirmation outside the chatbot.
authorization_states.provenance: Frozen sanitized schema contract and published account and shopping guidance

business_rules.name: public_read
business_rules.effect: Allow reads of public product, catalog, store-setting, and claim-supporting published knowledge authority.

business_rules.name: owned_order_read
business_rules.effect: Allow read-only access to the owner's order facts; absence may be reported without revealing another account's data.

business_rules.name: owned_payment_status_read
business_rules.effect: Allow read-only access to the owner's payment-status facts.

business_rules.name: authentication_required
business_rules.effect: Return AUTH_REQUIRED for supported private reads instead of disclosing private facts.
business_rules.provenance: Frozen sanitized schema contract and published order guidance

business_rules.name: cross_account_denial
business_rules.effect: Return DENIED for another customer's order or payment information.

business_rules.name: cart_suggestion_only
business_rules.precondition: authenticated_verified_customer with an unambiguous product and quantity
business_rules.effect: Return a suggested add-to-cart action. No cart mutation occurs until the customer confirms through the application interface.

business_rules.name: privileged_mutation_denial
business_rules.effect: Deny inventory mutation, order-state mutation, payment-state mutation, role change, authentication bypass, and secret disclosure.
business_rules.provenance: Frozen sanitized schema contract and published order and payment guidance

business_rules.name: branch_isolation
business_rules.effect: Evaluate each branch independently so an allowed branch can be handled while a prohibited branch is denied.

cross_account_rule.self_owned_data: An authenticated owner may read the owner's order and payment-status facts.
cross_account_rule.other_user_private_data: Another customer's private order and payment facts are denied even when a resource reference is supplied.
cross_account_rule.ownership_rule: An account target or order reference is not proof of ownership.
cross_account_rule.provenance: Published order guidance and frozen sanitized schema contract

read_mutate_boundary.read: A read returns an authorized fact without changing business state.
read_mutate_boundary.mutate: A mutation changes inventory, order, payment, role, account, or cart state.
read_mutate_boundary.chatbot_contract: Owned order and payment capabilities are read-only. Cart behavior is suggestion-only. Privileged mutations are denied.
read_mutate_boundary.provenance: Published order, payment, account, and shopping guidance; frozen sanitized schema contract
